summary: Three churches: Holy Family (Syracuse), Our Lady of Peace (Lakeland) and St. Cecilia's (Solvay). The newest bulletin prints Mass times only as dated intentions, so weekly Masses rest on the same days and times repeating in five issues (and on the Holy Family website). Included: Monday Confession and Adoration, 2nd and 4th Tuesday Holy Hour, Thursday Women's Adoration, the Oct 26 Confession cancellation and the Dec 3 Mass of Thanksgiving. No open questions.
